text: U.K. CPI falls to 3.2% year-on-year in November, with core inflation matching the decline, driven by lower food, tobacco, and clothing prices amid weak growth and rising unemployment.

meta.note: Inflation easing and labor softening coexist without a resolved policy outcome at the snapshot time.

text: Warner Bros. Discovery board unanimously recommends shareholders reject a Paramount Skydance tender offer and proceed with a proposed merger with Netflix, citing financing certainty and deal structure amid competing bids.

meta.note: Competing offers remain live; financing backstop commitments differ at the snapshot point.
